Yes

The evaluation is solidly framed to rest on concrete evidence. The task force includes every essential seat for sign-off: architect, red dev, green dev, adversarial QA, and an independent sign-off seat running gate filters and networked checks in a fresh clone under the heavy-run lock. All roles are properly staffed with pinned models in distinct contexts, and the sign-off seat is appropriately decoupled from the implementation seat.
